descriptions.d24f_float_vector_fill_insert_80359f84: Inserts n copies of a float at pos in a vector (start +0, finish +4, storage end +12). With spare capacity it moves the tail up with memmove and fills; otherwise it allocates max(size, n) more elements through 0x80212fd4 with fallback 0x803413d8, copies prefix, fills, copies suffix, releases old storage via 0x802134fc and sets the new bounds.
